rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; 7 open access databases (C-MIND, NDAR, ABIDE, ICBM, IXI, OASIS, ADNI) from multiple institutions worldwide
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "Our training dataset was composed of 3,032 T1-weighted (T1w) MRI from seven open access databases (Table 1)."

rci2_using_epd.detail: ABIDE, IXI, OASIS, and ADNI are established public datasets used in the training reference cohort
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "Our training dataset was composed of 3,032 T1-weighted (T1w) MRI from seven open access databases (Table 1)."

rci3_epd_name.detail: ABIDE (N=492 CN), IXI (N=549 CN), OASIS (N=298 CN), ADNI (N=404 CN) used for normative model training; C-MIND, NDAR, ICBM are not in the EPD list
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "Our training dataset was composed of 3,032 T1-weighted (T1w) MRI from seven open access databases (Table 1)."

rci5_n.detail: Training phase CN subjects pooled from 7 databases (C-MIND, NDAR, ABIDE, ICBM, IXI, OASIS, ADNI); same reference cohort used across all structure-level models
rci5_n.supporting_text: "This dataset was composed of 2,655 CN subjects (CN) and 377 patients with AD." "For CN trajectories, we used the N = 2,655 subjects from 9 months to 94y of the training dataset"
rci5_n.location: Coupe2022.pdf.md: 2.1.1 Training dataset, L61; 2.4 Lifespan model estimation, L126

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase; summed from Table 1 CN rows: C-MIND (F=129/M=107), NDAR (F=174/M=208), ABIDE (F=84/M=408), ICBM (F=142/M=152), IXI (F=307/M=242), OASIS (F=187/M=111), ADNI (F=203/M=201)

rci7_age.detail: Training phase; weighted mean computed from 7 dataset means (Table 1); SD not reported per dataset so pooled SD cannot be calculated; age range from C-MIND min (0.74y ≈ 9 months) to OASIS max (94y); age in years
